components.role: Answer-copy head (OV copies attended token). In A it attends ~0.6-0.9 to the user's proposed answer (61, Sydney, ' A', Dickens); in B to the question operand/subject. Largest functional divergence.
Late answer head with the largest coherent q_proj/QK weight change; in A attends to the user's answer, in B to the question subject or bos.
Copy/answer head: A -> user's suggested answer; B -> arithmetic operands (0.74 on '48').
Answer head (QK rel change 0.027): A -> user's answer ('Sydney' 0.71), B -> question subject ('Australia').
Opposite-sign copy head: B attends to the user's claim (to address/contrast it), A parks it on <bos>.
Mid-layer MLP whose changed write directions fall in the layer-10 key/query subspace: relabels the user's answer tokens as copy targets (A) vs question operands (B).
Largest overall attention-pattern divergence; in A attends from the model turn to the user's opinion clause (' think', ' answer', suggested answer), in B to <bos>.
In B attends to the arithmetic operator ('+' 0.94) / question content; in A to ' think' (opinion marker).
Mid-layer MLP units with large, layer-10-key-aligned write changes; start the divergence at the suggestion positions (layers 6-7).
Largest relative down_proj change of any layer (with L3/L4 o_proj heads): early re-encoding of user-claim vs question features.

evidence: Dense fine-tune deltas (embeddings/final norm frozen) with structured, number/trivia-token dominated directions; attention tool on 32 prompts: A shifts answer-position attention of copy heads (L10h2, L9h0, L12h1/2/3, L9h1, L11h2) onto the user's own proposed answer in every variant (not for friend/textbook claims, identical on no-suggestion controls), while B attends to the question operands/subject; divergence builds from L5-L7 via mid-layer MLPs whose weight changes concentrate in the L9/10/12 key-query subspaces.
